grade.answer_reason: The answer says no: the Marrowlog 2.4 Q2 report measured only plain TCP with lines of 200 bytes or shorter (180,000 lines/s on 1 vCPU), TLS was not measured, and the team should wait for the Q4 report or run its own test. Its details about the 900-byte lines and the agent config come from local files it read, not from invented figures.
